guideline: Workers were asked to choose which simplification expresses meaning best, is more fluent, and is easier to read and understand; they also rated fluency, adequacy, and simplicity on a continuous scale.
Workers rated each simplified sentence on three criteria: 1) adequacy (meaning preservation), 2) fluency (grammaticality), 3) simplicity (ease of understanding).
